name: get_profile
description: Read authoritative current profile, revision, confirmation and missing inputs before updating or calculating.

name: update_profile
description: Propose explicitly supplied facts. This invalidates confirmation. Never use this tool to confirm. Amounts are USD; income/annualSupport are annual, budget monthly, all other money one-time.

patch.description: JSON object string. Allowed keys: dependents (string), income, annualSupport, years, mortgage, debts, education, finalExpenses, otherNeeds, employerCoverage, personalCoverage, savings, budget (number or null), priorities (string). Unknown is null; explicit exclusions are 0. years must be a whole number 1-60. No other keys.

name: calculate_needs
description: Calculate only after the customer confirms all current inputs in the interface. Return exact structured line items and assumptions. Never substitute model arithmetic for a rejected tool call.

name: explore_scenario
description: Compare ONE assumption to the confirmed original without changing it. Provide either years OR excludeEmployer; omit both to reset to original.

years.description: Optional hypothetical support period, 1 to 60 years.

excludeEmployer.description: Optional hypothetical that employer coverage is unavailable.

name: show_education
description: Open a comparison popup for a key detail with charts, term/whole-life toggle and tradeoffs. No quotes or product purchase.

focus.description: The relevant captured highlight to explore. Defaults to support.
